note: Both forms at once — a filing names no `contactId`; the agent keys a filing on (contextId, subjectDid, knownByPersona), and a request that also named a contact would let a caller graft one peer's disclosure onto another's record.
Annotating form carrying a document — an annotation never appends a revision, so a `document` beside `contactId` has no defined meaning.
Annotating form that changes nothing — `contactId` alone names a contact and no annotation, which the anyOf over the annotation members refuses.
A petname given and removed in the same request — dependentSchemas makes `removePetname` exclude `petname`.
`removeLists: false` — only `true` is meaningful, so only `true` is accepted; a false remove flag would be a second way to say "unchanged".

payload.petname: Sam, who I met at the climbing gym on a Thursday and who knows Dana's brother

note: Petname with a line break — one line, so a surface that shows it beside a display name cannot be made to render a second, forged line.
Empty `lists` — a contact on no list has no `lists`; take it off every list with `removeLists`, so there is one way to say "none".
Repeated list identifier — `lists` is a set.
`directoryRef` without `entryId` — a link to a community and no entry would mark the contact as known through that community while naming nothing the client can join on.
`entryId` outside its pattern — it is opaque, carried exactly as the directory returned it, and never contains a separator a client might split on.
`directoryRef` with an unknown member — additionalProperties: false catches `memberDid`; the link names an entry, never the member's DID.
Response without `annotationsChanged` — a client could not tell an applied change from a no-op.
Response echoing the petname — additionalProperties: false; a response carries identifiers and flags, never annotation text that a log would then keep.

Linking with a DID as well — a request naming `subjectDid` and a document is a filing, and one naming neither is a link; one that named a DID beside a bare directory link would leave the agent to guess which contact it means.
Linking without the persona — a contact belongs to a relationship, so the agent cannot find or make the contact for an entry without the persona that knows it.
Response carrying the pre-1.2 `created` flag — renamed `wasCreated`, since `created` is reserved for a timestamp; additionalProperties: false rejects the old name and `wasCreated` is required.
